svg.text: The company is phasing out the old system.
Phase out means remove gradually, not stop
overnight. It is separable: phase the system
out; phase it out. Use phasing for an ongoing
A: Are we stopping the old system
B: No. We are phasing it out over three
A: Will both systems run during the transition?
B: Yes, until everyone has moved to the new
Describe a gradual transition using phase out
and a time frame. Model: We will phase out
paper forms over the next six months.
